mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pcd_admin_audit_log_table ( audit_admin_id, audit_admin_name, audit_admin_role, audit_action, audit_resource, audit_resource_id, audit_detail, audit_request_method, audit_request_path, audit_client_ip, audit_user_agent, audit_status, audit_error_message, audit_created_at ) VALUES ( #{auditAdminId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{auditAdminName}, #{auditAdminRole}, #{auditAction}, #{auditResource}, #{auditResourceId}, #{auditDetail}, #{auditRequestMethod}, #{auditRequestPath}, #{auditClientIp}, #{auditUserAgent}, #{auditStatus}, #{auditErrorMessage}, #{auditCreatedAt} );
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pcd_admin_audit_log_table WHERE audit_created_at >= #{since};
